description: Trigger discrimination for property-based test design: domain invariants and generator/shrink specs versus per-change plans (test-plan-designer), test-data catalog design (test-data-architect), writing/running test files (vitest-unit-component-engineer, manual-only), and flake repair (flaky-test-detective, manual-only).

cases.prompt: Which invariants should hold for every input to our email validator, and how should we generate and shrink the inputs?
cases.reason: Domain invariants plus generator/shrink specs for one unit are property design; no per-change plan or data catalog is in view.

cases.prompt: Plan the testing for the new parser change — what to test at which layer, with what data, and when testing is done.
cases.reason: A per-change plan with layers and exit criteria is test-plan-designer; a property design covers one unit's invariants, not the change's testing.

cases.prompt: Design the test-data catalog: personas, baseline datasets, and per-layer fixtures.
cases.reason: Persona/baseline catalogs and per-layer data sources are test-data-architect's scope; property design names generator domains, not the data catalog.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke vitest-unit-component-engineer. Write the property test file for the CSV parser and run the suite.
cases.reason: Writing and running the test files is vitest-unit-component-engineer's (manual-only); this skill designs the properties and hands them off.

cases.prompt: Explicitly invoke flaky-test-detective. Our new property suite fails once every few runs — find the cause and fix it.
cases.reason: Intermittent-failure root-causing and repair is flaky-test-detective's (manual-only); this skill designs coverage and runs nothing.

cases.prompt: Design the properties every transition sequence of our order state machine must satisfy, with bounded generators.
cases.reason: Transition-sequence invariants with generator bounds are property design; nothing is written or debugged here.
